trigger_condition.device_trigger: Model parameters and their gradients are located on different devices, such as cuda:0 and cuda:1, when a gradient clipping or aggregation operation is called.
trigger_condition.state_trigger: Gradients are populated on a different device than their corresponding parameters.
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: Call torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_ over a parameter list that contains parameters or gradients on different devices.
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Parameters and gradients must be distributed across multiple devices, e.g., cuda:0 and cuda:1, and the operation must require aggregating or clipping gradients across those devices.

bug_oracle.description: Calling clip_grad_norm_ with parameters or gradients on different devices raises an exception.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Vary device placement of a subset of parameters or gradients so that some reside on cuda:0 and others on cuda:1.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Create a small neural network module, split parameters across multiple devices, run forward/backward to generate gradients on those devices, and collect the mixed-device parameters.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Force parameter and gradient device mismatch by moving parameters after backward or by assigning gradients from tensors on different devices.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Initialize module -> split parameters across devices -> run forward/backward on corresponding devices -> call clip_grad_norm_ over all parameters -> observe exception.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: The expected oracle is an exception such as RuntimeError when mixed-device gradients or parameters are supplied; success or a crash under mixed devices indicates inconsistent handling.
